# Synthetic semantic fixtures

These original examples exercise invariants and independently specified arithmetic.
They do not represent company products, manufacturing-qualified designs, actual stock,
or real bench results. None establishes a native-tool result by itself.

Implement adapters/tests that consume these expectations. The board expectation fixture
specifies desired semantics but is not a KiCad file; create the native fixture with the
pinned toolchain and compare it to these independent expectations. Private acceptance
examples remain outside this public tree and are not CI prerequisites.
